'''Pre-Shaped Detonite Charges''' were manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] Costing two hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], the charges were capable of penetrating materials such as [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]], [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]], and [[Durelium/Legends|durelium]].<ref name="PP" />
